metadata.extraction_method: Deterministic lookup over Princeton WordNet 3.0 index.{noun,verb,adj,adv} and data.{noun,verb,adj,adv} using standard WordNet Morphy (.exc irregular lists + inflectional suffix detachment across n/v/a/r). Each synset records its verbatim 8-digit byte-offset ID, canonical NLTK synset name, POS tag, lemma list, and definition gloss (with quoted usage examples after '; "' excluded). Zero manual edits.
